text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the fall of Agnes Digital's junior
year, and the
other runners are staying active
throughout this
season.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I'm over here! Finally, the
big race is
starting! I've been dying to
see this!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The start of this year's Mile
Championship is just moments away!
Who do you think will be first to
fly
down the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here's King Halo coming in from outside!
King
Halo! King Halo finishes second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, King fans? It's a shame
I
couldn't finish first, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've found my new path on the Sprint
and Mile
tour! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear the confidence in her
voice?!
Ohhhh, the tears are flowing
down my face like
waterfalls!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you get what she's talking about? Do
you want me to explain? I'm gonna
explain, okay?
Omg, I really can't turn
off the waterworks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She goes on without giving me a moment
to
respond.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King was always focusing on going down the
traditional route in order to prove
her skill to her
mother because she
respects her so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But then! Oh, man! She wowed everyone
by
changing paths this year! She turned
her back on
what she once longed for.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She's showing us that being true to
herself and
finding her own path is the
best way to gain her
mother's respect!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She struggled a lot after making her
decision, but she's overcome those
doubts today! I know all about how
difficult that was for her!
I could fill my 
entire timeline talking about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to stop her once she gets going
about Umamusume. Running on the
track herself has
only deepened her
attachment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Quick, Trainer. Hide.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's another Umamusume lost in a
chasm of
worry, just like King was.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look, there she is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Everyone was so incredible, yet... here I am...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto's progress has slowed recently,
allowing
Opera O to rocket ahead of
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O has been the center of
attention at the Classics, so, naturally,
she's considered the
favorite for the
Arima Kinen this year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Doto still hasn't run in a
single G1
race yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The old me would simply bask in the
inspiration
from Doto trying her
hardest...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But now that I've debuted, I feel like I
understand
her struggle a little.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly what's causing it.
It's clear
as day.
choice_data_list: If only we knew why progress has s...
If only we knew the reason for the...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital claims to understand so
casually
that I have to ask her what the
reason is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Which is to say, Doto isn't fully
race-ready yet.
She's still growing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You know about Umamusume's race-readiness,
right? It's the time when
they transform from cute
little sprouts
into fiery smokeshows.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto is what you'd consider a late
bloomer. She's
still waiting to sprout.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So there's really no need for her to
worry! Her
problems will resolve
themselves with time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...That's my diagnosis at least, speaking
as
someone who has observed lots and
lots of Umas.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I really hope that someone notices and
says something to her. I bet you that
would go a long
way toward easing her
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's Yu?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaagh?! M-m-m-me?! Nowaynoway! No. Waaay!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It would be way too impudent for
someone like me to impose my opinion
on her! And what if it
somehow made
things worse?! What would I do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fans don't give advice to their idols!
And any fan
who forgets their place gets
hit with the
banhammer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
E-everyone's welcome to their own
opinions. But
there's an unbreachable
wall separating me and
Doto.
choice_data_list: You're not just a fan anymore, are...
You're not just another fan anymor...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A fellow runner? Hmm...
choice_data_list: Why not do something for her as a ...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying... Listen, I'm just a
plain old
runner. But Doto... She's a
runner with
immeasurable charm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Although... now that I'm a runner too, I
do kinda
have a sense of how she feels...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital grows silent for a moment.
And
then...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? You really think I should say something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I still feel like it would be super
arrogant
of me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... If a fellow simp says so,
I'll try and
work up
the confidence. I won't run
away...
choice_data_list: I don't think that's the case, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll... um... just say a few words...
Nothing
big...
Oh, but that's still taboo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital hypes herself up, and
then...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhhhhh, h-hey, Doto! Do you have a
moment to
talk? It'll only take five
seconds, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do you need something, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about race-readiness? It's
pretty useful information. If you want, I
can tell you
about it a bit. So, basically,
you know how you're an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that night, Agnes Digital is feeling
down.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I really did it now. I went up to
the real-life
Doto and totally lost it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I lectured her for ten whole minutes! I
was
babbling away as fast as a machine
gun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I just want to go throw myself at her feet
and beg
for forgiveness...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't have enough self-esteem left
to even
dare hope so... I'm just a
chicken...
choice_data_list: Still, it might have been good ref...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I know I've debuted and all that, but I'm
still only supposed to simp quietly from
the sidelines...
How could I have
forgotten myself like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital broke her vow of
non-intervention.
What happens now,
nobody knows.
